name: @180workspace/sdk
description: Official Universal Client SDK for 180 Identity (SSO/Auth) and 180 Pay (Checkout)

scripts.build: tsc && npx esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.mjs --external:@workspace/identity-sdk --external:react --external:react-dom && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.copyFileSync('../identity-sdk/src/180-core-sdk.js', './dist/180-core-sdk.js'); fs.copyFileSync('../identity-sdk/src/180-core-sdk.min.js', './dist/180-core-sdk.min.js'); fs.copyFileSync('../identity-sdk/src/180-core-sdk.d.ts', './dist/180-core-sdk.d.ts');"
